applicant.name: Prof. Dr. Ivan Kovač
applicant.organisation: Medical University, Department of Infectious Diseases and Vaccinology

purpose: We want to estimate how many hospitalisations a broader pneumococcal vaccination programme could prevent in each age group.
question: How many people were admitted to hospital with pneumonia as the main diagnosis, by age group?
definitions: Pneumonia admission = inpatient encounter with a main diagnosis (primary_icd10) starting with J18.
Count each person once, even if they were admitted several times.
Age groups on 31 December 2025: 0-17, 18-44, 45-64, 65-79, 80 and older.
Report per age group: persons with at least one pneumonia admission.
